# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No fixes required. The review approved the implementation with zero findings or gaps. All code from the plan_and_implement stage (migration registry in save.rs, new SimError variants in actions.rs, 4 new tests in save_load.rs) remains unchanged. Full validation suite confirmed clean.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Verified review outcome: approved with no findings_or_gaps and no follow_up_or_amendments — no code changes needed.
2. [Completed] Ran full quality check suite (cargo test && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check) to confirm the implementation remains clean after the review cycle.

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test: all 148 tests pass across all crates (including 10 save_load tests with 4 new migration tests)
- cargo clippy -- -D warnings: zero warnings
- cargo fmt --check: no formatting diff
- Review outcome was 'approved' with empty findings_or_gaps and empty follow_up_or_amendments arrays

## Outstanding Risks

- The original SchemaVersionMismatch error variant is preserved but no longer emitted by save.rs; downstream code matching on it will compile but never trigger from save loading (flagged in plan_and_implement, unchanged)
- The v2→v3 migration is frozen as raw-JSON logic independent of WaterState::rescale_totals_for_volume; this is by design for migration immutability (flagged in plan_and_implement, unchanged)
